content: Ayush Pande wrote on Aug 26, 2026, about repurposing a 2014 Lenovo G510 and an Acer Predator Helios 300 as Proxmox VE servers for home self-hosting. The Acer Predator Helios 300's non-removable battery was a major issue for his home server experiments. He solved it by creating a Home Assistant automation pipeline using a $9 smart plug. The approach demonstrates a budget-friendly way to handle battery-related problems in recycled laptop servers.

PC hardware and gaming writer Ayush Pande published an article on August 26, 2026, detailing his experience repurposing older x86 machines, such as a 2014 Lenovo G510 and an Acer Predator Helios 300, into low-power Proxmox VE nodes. He identifies the non-removable battery on the Acer Predator Helios 300 as the biggest issue when using a recycled laptop for home server tasks. Pande constructed a Home Assistant automation pipeline integrated with a $9 smart plug to resolve this power management problem. The article explains how this setup overcomes the limitations inherent in repurposing laptops with built-in batteries for continuous server operation.

Right-wing commentator Sydney Watson shared a 2024 video of Connecticut Sun center Brittney Griner and speculated the WNBA refuses to define "woman" because there is already a man in the league, despite Griner being cisgender. The remark came amid a moral panic about transgender women in sports fueled by MAGA figures and Donald Trump, with former swimmer Riley Gaines—who tied for fifth with transgender competitor Lia Thomas at the 2022 NCAA championships—emerging as a prominent anti-trans activist. Indiana Fever player Sophie Cunningham has also embraced a spokeswoman role for the movement, following a July ESPN profile.

Bearded capuchin monkeys (Sapajus libidinosus) in northeastern Brazil hunt and eat small vertebrates more often when fruits are scarce. Researchers analyzed over 5,000 hours of observational data collected between June 2006 and December 2010 to study these habits. Noemi Spagnoletti stated, "We repeatedly observed the monkeys actively hunting and consuming vertebrates, including lizards, snakes and iguanas." The findings, reported August 26 in PLOS One, provide insights into the early evolution of human diets and the shift to meatier fare.

Ayush Pande converted an old Acer Predator Helios 300 laptop into a Proxmox home server, but the device’s non-removable battery became a major issue for continuous server use. To solve the problem, he built a Home Assistant automation pipeline that uses a $9 smart plug. Published on Aug. 26, 2026, the report describes how this inexpensive hardware and automation setup helps keep the recycled laptop server practical. The story highlights Proxmox’s suitability for repurposing older x86 systems into low-power home servers.

"Укртелеком" готує запуск віртуального мобільного оператора U Mobile. Оператор об'єднає мобільні тарифи з домашнім оптичним інтернетом у єдині пакети для приватних абонентів. Це вихід компанії на ринок мобільного зв'язку.

Right-wing Australian YouTuber Sydney Watson, who has over a million X followers, posted Monday speculation that a man may already play in the WNBA after sharing a 2024 video of Connecticut Sun center Brittney Griner. Watson suggested the league refuses to define “woman” and explicitly exclude men because “there is already a man ... in the league,” despite Griner being a cisgender woman. The report situates this comment amid a moral panic about transgender women in sports that it says has been ginned up by MAGA figures, Donald Trump, and athletes such as Riley Gaines and Indiana Fever’s Sophie Cunningham. Although the article asserts there are no transgender women in the WNBA, it labels Watson’s remarks baseless and inflammatory.

У Норвегії на авіабазі поблизу Тронгейма, де розмістять винищувачі F-35, заступила на чергування перша протидронова установка C-UAS. Вона захищає об’єкти від безпілотників вагою до 150 кг, виявляючи та нейтралізуючи їх. Розгортання прискорили підозрілі дрони поблизу бази у вересні 2025 року; подібні установки з’являться і на інших об’єктах ЗС Норвегії. У матеріалі також зазначено, що Фінляндія закупить FPV-дрони для навчань на 14 млн євро, а 80% опитаних у Німеччині вважають країну погано підготовленою до захисту від дронів.

Bearded capuchin monkeys (Sapajus libidinosus) in northeastern Brazil hunt and consume small vertebrates more often when fruit is scarce, according to a study reported August 26 in PLOS One. Zoologist Noemi Spagnoletti of Sapienza University of Rome and her colleagues analyzed more than 5,000 hours of observations collected between June 2006 and December 2010, correlating meat-eating habits with seasonal plant food availability, temperature, and the age and sex of the monkeys. “We repeatedly observed the monkeys actively hunting and consuming vertebrates, including lizards, snakes and iguanas,” Spagnoletti said. The findings may help researchers understand the early evolution of human diets and the lineage’s shift to meatier fare.

У Норвегії заступила на чергування перша спеціалізована установка протидронової оборони (C-UAS) на злітній смузі авіабази поблизу Тронгейма, де планувалось розмістити винищувачі F-35. Про це повідомило NRK, а інформацію оприлюднила «Європейська правда». Установка захищає стаціонарні об'єкти від безпілотників вагою до 150 кг, дозволяючи виявляти, ідентифікувати та нейтралізувати апарати. Розгортання спроможностей прискорили підозрілі безпілотники, помічені поблизу бази у вересні 2025 року, згодом ще кілька таких систем прикриють інші об'єкти Збройних сил Норвегії.

The claim targeted Brittney Griner, who is explicitly identified in the article as a cisgender woman. The piece frames the post as part of a broader MAGA-driven moral panic over transgender women in sports, also naming anti-trans activists such as Riley Gaines and WNBA player Sophie Cunningham.

A study published August 26 in PLOS One found that bearded capuchin monkeys in northeastern Brazil hunt and eat small vertebrates, including lizards, snakes and iguanas, more often when fruit is scarce. Noemi Spagnoletti and colleagues analyzed data from more than 5,000 hours of observations collected between June 2006 and December 2010, comparing diet with food availability, temperature and the monkeys’ age and sex. The findings may provide insight into the early evolution of human diets and the shift toward meatier fare.

Right-wing commentator Sydney Watson posted on X: “Look, I'm not trying to do a conspiracy here,” before suggesting WNBA star Brittney Griner–a cisgender woman and Baylor legend–is a man, claiming the league’s refusal to define “woman” implies a man already plays in the league.
